NGA.note: A workshop where a foreign academic proposed a four-pillar AI policy roadmap; no rule, draft or authority stated.
A roadmap was proposed by a workshop keynote speaker, not the government; no government AI strategy stated.
A Digital Consumer Protection Handbook was launched by a university chair endowment; no rule, complaints body or enforcement for digital finance stated.

facts.fact: The Federal University of Technology, Minna, through the NCC Professorial Chair Endowment, hosted a two-day workshop from 9 September 2025 on AI and data governance for consumer protection, and launched a Digital Consumer Protection Handbook.
